blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu media community is mourning the death of veteran and multi-awarded broadcaster Sam Costanilla, who was found dead inside his vehicle in Barangay Inayawan, Cebu City, on Sunday morning, September 27. Costanilla, 68, was found in the driver’s seat of his vehicle, which had been parked near the annex building of the Inayawan Barangay Hall since Friday morning, September 25. Authorities are still determining the circumstances surrounding his death, with an autopsy pending.
